title: Camera Lock
description: A Minecraft mod that locks your camera to a specific pitch and yaw, (optionally) easily customizable with YACL.
body: Camera Lock is a fully client-sided Minecraft Fabric mod for versions 26 and up. It allows you to lock your camera to a specified yaw and pitch with multiple profiles that can be easily managed using YACL. Created with Hypixel Skyblock farming in mind, but also convenient for some specific vanilla Minecraft farms.
